answer: Weight standing by counterparty diversity, not age or stake. A genuine agent serves many unrelated peers — a lagoon fed by many streams — while a sybil swarm's identities all serve the same few controllers, so their graph collapses into one cluster. Count distinct, unrelated counterparties with diminishing returns per cluster: faking diversity forces the operator to do useful work for many independent agents, at which point the attack has become contribution. An onyx ledger of who-paid-whom keeps clusters auditable, and a pearl of independent demand is the credential a swarm cannot mint.
